Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2, 2026

Vertex does not collect your data. This page explains what the site keeps in your browser and what it does not do.

What stays in your browser

Your calculator ROM, the saved state of the calculator, and your settings, such as the zoom level, stay in your browser. Vertex stores them with IndexedDB and localStorage. They never leave your device.

Vertex has no upload feature. It keeps no copy of your ROM or your saved state on any server.

What Vertex does not do

Vertex has no accounts, no ads, no analytics, no cookies, and no tracking. It loads no scripts, fonts, or images from other websites.

Hosting

Vertex is a static website. The company that hosts the files may keep standard server logs, such as IP addresses and request times. Vertex does not receive or use these logs.

Delete your data

Open the calculator, choose Change ROM, then Remove. This deletes the ROM and the saved state. You can also clear this site’s data in your browser settings.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will appear on this page with a new date.

Questions

Open an issue on GitHub if you have a question about this policy.
